name: Q-Tip
sources: Ambrosia for Heads — the making of The Low End Theory (https://ambrosiaforheads.com/2016/09/a-tribe-called-quest-low-end-theory-making-the-album-interview/)
KQED — Ron Carter and the Low End Theory (https://www.kqed.org/arts/10137113/ron-carter-and-the-low-end-theory)
notes: The low-end doctrine, stated as parameters. The research calls the bass "the organising principle" and names a live jazz bassist playing the parts, so this is the only model on this axis where the bass is the most-authored part: `independent_riff` at `followRootsProb` 0.35 — the loosest here — over a 24-semitone register with a six-interval passing-tone set. Everything else gets out of its way: the research says the mid-range is "deliberately empty" and the drums are "thin mid-range so bass and voice own the mix", so the melody register starts at 67 with `emptyBarBias` 0.24. The kick is the other fingerprint — "kick on 1 and the 4th 8th" is `secondaryAnchor` "2&", which nothing else on this axis uses. The Ummah's swing is 0.62 with a loose 0.66 quantize, since the research says the later work adopts Dilla-style placement. Harmony is 7th/9th/11th Dorian colour: ninths at 0.35 is the richest on this axis. ⚠ `medium` because the research rates it high-medium: the album-level making-of and the live-bass session are documented, but no drum programming numbers exist. The specific inferred parameter is `session.humanize.quantizeStrength` — "Dilla-style loose placement" is a description, and 0.66 is this author's number for it. ⚠ The i–VI–ii–v family is INFERRED; the research names ii–V–i, i–iv and modal one-chord vamps. ⚠ The bass ceiling came down from 52 to 49 so it stays under a chord part that starts at 50 — `coherence.rs` requires the highest bass note to sit at or below the lowest chord note, and this model overlapped by 3. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 973/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980**, so its style pool was opened: octave_echo, bell_echo. ⛔ `counter.rs` reads five styles and this roster only ever authored three — `bell_echo` is a real answer shape the engine can already play and the dataset had never asked for. ⚠ `sustain_pad` is deliberately not added: it is a held pad rather than an answer, and adding one to win a variety score would change what the record sounds like. ⚠ **`melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.24 to 0.1, and this is the parameter that was actually saturating the countermelody** (this model reached 972/1000 against a floor of 980). An empty bar produces an empty counter region, and every empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one — so silence is the one thing a seed cannot vary. Across the roster 57 of the 58 models failing this gate authored an empty-bar bias, averaging 0.246, against 0.115 for the models that passed. The space in the lead is real and is kept; what is removed is the amount of it that made every take collide.
